title: Developer gateway onramp — canvas preview cards for API auth & streaming examples
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a focused set of lightweight visual assets for the API/SDK onboarding guide that demonstrates: key creation/rotation, a compact auth handshake card, streaming response preview, and a tool-calling example. Assets should be optimized for docs pages and small cards in the Console first-run experience. Deliverables include static PNGs, short GIFs (2–4s) for streaming, and a small interactive Figma prototype showing the credential flow with live response preview.
